endpoints.description: Recent public posts from a Facebook Page, with text, reaction, comment and share counts, and the publish timestamp. Logged out, Facebook server-renders only the newest one to three stories and loads the rest on scroll behind an authenticated call — measured 2026-08-20 across four different Page URL shapes — so this returns the head of the feed, not its history. `raw.hasMoreBehindCursor` reports whether Facebook says there is more.

params.name: url

endpoints.name: facebook.pageReels

Reads the Page's reels tab first and falls back to its video grid, which renders around twenty entries with titles, view counts and durations — so a Page with no reels returns its videos rather than an error. Items are keyed by video id and can be passed straight to /v1/facebook/post or /v1/facebook/post-transcript.

params.name: url
params.description: Page URL, @handle, slug, or numeric page id

endpoints.name: facebook.postComments

Logged out, Facebook renders the "Most relevant" head of the thread (roughly the first ten comments) rather than the whole thread — the post's full comment total is on /v1/facebook/post. Use /v1/facebook/comment-replies for the replies under one comment. `likeCount` is only as precise as Facebook publishes it: comment reactions ship in abbreviated form ("2.4K") with no exact figure anywhere in the payload, so counts above about a thousand are rounded at source.

params.name: url
params.description: Full post, video, or reel URL

params.name: url
params.description: Page URL, @handle, slug, or numeric page id

endpoints.name: instagram.reelsSearch
endpoints.description: Reels matching a keyword, from Instagram's own keyword search rather than its hashtag index — the two return genuinely different sets, so this never quietly substitutes one for the other. Results are whatever Instagram ranked for the query at that moment.

endpoints.name: instagram.search
endpoints.description: Instagram's blended search — the one behind the search box. Returns three buckets: `users` as unified Creators, plus `hashtags` and `places`, which have no unified equivalent and keep Instagram's own shape. One page only; this surface has no cursor.

params.name: type
params.description: Restrict to one kind of result

endpoints.name: instagram.transcript
endpoints.description: The caption track Instagram published for a reel or video, as one text block plus timed cues. We return Instagram's own track and never transcribe the audio ourselves, so a transcript here is always what the platform said rather than what a model guessed. **Read this before relying on it:** checked against 12 real reel payloads, none carried a caption track in any form — no inline transcript, and DASH manifests with video and audio tracks only. On current evidence Instagram publishes none, so this returns `empty_result` (free, never charged) rather than a transcript. It is shipped as experimental so the shape is stable if that changes.

params.name: url
params.description: Reel, post or IGTV URL, or a bare shortcode

endpoints.name: instagram.trendingReels
endpoints.description: Reels off Instagram's public Explore grid. Worth knowing what this is and is not: Explore is region-shaped, so what comes back depends on where the request exits, and it is Instagram's editorial surface rather than a global chart. There is no public trending feed on Instagram; this is the closest one that exists.

endpoints.name: instagram.userEmbed

endpoints.description: A profile read off Instagram's public embed card, with the embed HTML in `raw.html` for anyone who wants to render it. Instagram publishes embeds so third parties can display them, which makes this the profile path it has the least reason to gate — the same reasoning that puts the post embed on /v1/instagram/post's fallback. It carries fewer fields than /v1/instagram/profile; reach for it when that one is blocked, or when you want the markup.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@nike), or a full instagram.com profile URL

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@nike), or a full instagram.com profile URL. Optional if `user_id` is given.

endpoints.description: Public details for a pin: title, description, destination link, saves, reactions and full-resolution media. Saves map to `shareCount`.

endpoints.name: pinterest.search
endpoints.description: Public Pinterest search results for a query, as unified posts.

endpoints.name: pinterest.userBoards

endpoints.name: reddit.post
endpoints.description: One Reddit post with its score, comment count, body text and media. Use `reddit.postComments` for the comment tree — they are separate endpoints so a post with no comments is still a paid, cached result rather than an empty one.

params.name: url

endpoints.name: reddit.commentReplies

params.name: depth

endpoints.name: reddit.postComments
endpoints.description: A post's comment tree, flattened into reading order with `parentId` preserved so callers can rebuild it. Reddit collapses deep threads behind continuation stubs; fetch those with `reddit.commentReplies`.

params.name: url
params.description: Post URL (reddit.com/r/.../comments/...) or a post id

params.name: sort
params.description: Reddit's comment sorts. "confidence" is the site default ("Best").

endpoints.name: reddit.search
endpoints.description: Reddit post search, site-wide or restricted to one subreddit with `subreddit`. Falls back to the Atom feed when the JSON surface is blocked.

params.name: query
params.description: Search terms. Reddit's own syntax works, e.g. `flair:"news"`.

endpoints.name: reddit.subreddit
endpoints.description: Posts from a subreddit, sorted the way Reddit sorts them. `sort=top` and `sort=controversial` accept a `timeframe`. Falls back to Reddit's Atom feed when the JSON surface is blocked — `raw.via` says which answered, and the Atom path returns no scores or comment counts.

params.name: subreddit
params.description: Subreddit name ("aww", "r/aww") or a full reddit.com/r/... URL

endpoints.name: reddit.subredditDetails
endpoints.description: Public metadata for a subreddit: subscribers, people online now, description, icons, creation date, and whether it is private or restricted.

params.name: subreddit
params.description: Subreddit name ("aww", "r/aww") or a full reddit.com/r/... URL

endpoints.name: reddit.user
endpoints.description: A Reddit account's public profile: display name, description, avatar, account age, and karma (returned under `raw.karma`, since the unified schema has no karma field).

endpoints.name: reddit.userPosts
endpoints.description: Posts submitted by a Reddit account, newest first by default. Falls back to the account's Atom feed when the JSON surface is blocked.

endpoints.name: rumble.channelVideos

params.name: handle

endpoints.name: rumble.search
endpoints.description: Public Rumble video search results, 25 per page.

endpoints.name: rumble.video
endpoints.description: Public metadata for a Rumble video: exact view count, likes and dislikes, comment count, duration, upload date, channel and follower count.

params.name: url

endpoints.name: rumble.comments

params.name: url

endpoints.name: rumble.transcript
endpoints.description: A Rumble video's captions as one text block plus timed cues. Returns the requested language when the video has it, otherwise the default track.

params.name: url

endpoints.name: snapchat.profile

endpoints.name: snapchat.spotlight

endpoints.name: snapchat.spotlightComments

endpoints.name: soundcloud.artist

params.name: handle

endpoints.name: soundcloud.artistTracks
endpoints.description: An artist's public uploads, newest first. Pass the `cursor` from the previous response to page.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (flume), or a full soundcloud.com profile URL

endpoints.name: soundcloud.track
endpoints.description: Public metadata for a SoundCloud track: plays, likes, reposts, comments, duration, genre and publisher metadata (ISRC, label, writers).

endpoints.name: spotify.album

params.name: id

endpoints.name: spotify.artist

params.name: id

endpoints.name: spotify.podcast

params.name: id

endpoints.name: spotify.podcastEpisodes
endpoints.description: Episodes for a Spotify podcast, newest first. Pass the `cursor` from the previous response to page.

params.name: id
params.description: Spotify show id, spotify:show: URI, or open.spotify.com show URL

endpoints.name: spotify.search
endpoints.description: Search Spotify's catalogue for tracks, albums, artists, podcasts or episodes. Uses Spotify's official Web API, so this endpoint needs app credentials; everything else on this platform is keyless.

endpoints.name: spotify.track
endpoints.description: Public Spotify track: title, artists, artwork, duration, release date, explicit flag, and the preview clip URL.

params.name: id
params.description: Spotify track id, spotify:track: URI, or open.spotify.com track URL

endpoints.name: threads.post
endpoints.description: A single public Threads post with like count, reply count, and any attached media.

endpoints.name: threads.profile
endpoints.description: Public Threads profile: follower count, bio, bio links, avatar, and verification status.

params.name: handle

endpoints.name: threads.search
endpoints.description: Public Threads posts matching a keyword.

endpoints.name: threads.searchUsers

endpoints.name: threads.userPosts
endpoints.description: Recent public posts from a Threads profile, with like and reply counts.

params.name: handle

endpoints.name: tiktok.collectionVideos
endpoints.description: Videos in a public TikTok collection — a creator-curated playlist of other people's posts as well as their own. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

endpoints.name: tiktok.commentReplies
endpoints.description: The reply thread under one TikTok comment. `parentId` on each reply points back at the comment it answers, so nested threads reconstruct cleanly. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: url
params.description: The video the comment is on — URL, share link, or numeric id

endpoints.name: tiktok.comments
endpoints.description: Top-level comments on a TikTok, with like counts, reply counts, pinned status and a flag for the creator's own replies. Use `tiktok.commentReplies` to expand a thread. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: url
params.description: Video URL (preferred), share link, or numeric video id

endpoints.name: tiktok.popularCreators
endpoints.description: Creators trending in a market, from TikTok's own Creative Center leaderboard. Filter by country, follower band and category.

params.name: region
params.description: Two-letter market code (US, GB, ID…). TikTok feeds and catalogues are per-market.

params.name: follower_band
params.description: Restrict to creators in this follower range

endpoints.name: tiktok.followers
endpoints.description: The public follower list for a TikTok account, newest first. TikTok caps how deep this list can be walked regardless of paging. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@nike), or a full tiktok.com profile URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.following
endpoints.description: The accounts a TikTok creator follows, newest first. Hidden entirely when the creator has set their following list to private. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@nike), or a full tiktok.com profile URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.hashtag
endpoints.description: Stats for a TikTok hashtag: total videos and total views, plus its description and cover. Read straight off the tag page, so it needs no signer.

params.name: hashtag
params.description: Tag without the # (fyp), or a full /tag/ URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.hashtagVideos
endpoints.description: TikToks carrying a given hashtag, in TikTok's own feed order. Resolves the tag to its numeric id from the tag page, then pages the feed — which needs a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: hashtag
params.description: Tag without the # (fyp), or a full /tag/ URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.live
endpoints.description: Details of a creator's stream while they are live: room id, title, cover, current viewers and start time. A creator who is not live returns `empty_result`, which is a real answer and costs nothing — that makes this usable as a cheap "are they live?" poll.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@nike), or a full tiktok.com profile URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.playlistVideos
endpoints.description: The videos inside one TikTok playlist, in the creator's chosen order. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

endpoints.name: tiktok.playlists
endpoints.description: The playlists (TikTok calls them "mixes") a creator has organised their videos into. Pair with `tiktok.playlistVideos` to walk one. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@nike), or a full tiktok.com profile URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.product
endpoints.description: A single TikTok Shop product: title, price, images, rating, review and sales counts, and the seller. Read from the server-rendered product page, so it needs no signer.

params.name: url
params.description: Product id, or a tiktok.com/view/product/… URL

params.name: region
params.description: Two-letter market code (US, GB, ID…). TikTok feeds and catalogues are per-market.

endpoints.name: tiktok.profile
endpoints.description: Public profile for a TikTok account: followers, following, video count, bio, bio link, verification and account region. Private accounts return their public shell with `isPrivate: true` rather than an error — that is a real answer, not a failure. Total likes received (TikTok's "hearts") is in `raw`, since it is a like total rather than the lifetime view count `viewCount` means elsewhere in the schema.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@nike), or a full tiktok.com profile URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.profileRegion
endpoints.description: The market TikTok assigns a creator's account. Read from TikTok's own `region` field — on the profile where TikTok publishes one, otherwise from the region stamped on the creator's recent posts. Never inferred from language, timezone or content.

endpoints.name: tiktok.searchKeyword
endpoints.description: TikToks matching a search term, with the same normalised engagement fields as every other post endpoint. `sort_by` and `date_posted` map onto TikTok's own search filters. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: date_posted
params.description: Restrict to videos posted within this window

endpoints.name: tiktok.searchSuggestions
endpoints.description: TikTok's typeahead completions for a partial query — what the platform thinks people are looking for. Useful for keyword research.

endpoints.name: tiktok.searchTop
endpoints.description: TikTok's blended "Top" search tab: the highest-ranked videos AND accounts for a query, returned as two typed lists. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

endpoints.name: tiktok.searchUsers
endpoints.description: TikTok accounts matching a query, with follower counts and verification. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

endpoints.name: tiktok.productReviews
endpoints.description: Public reviews on a TikTok Shop product, with star rating, reviewer, photos and the purchased variant. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: url
params.description: Product id, or a tiktok.com/view/product/… URL

params.name: region
params.description: Two-letter market code (US, GB, ID…). TikTok feeds and catalogues are per-market.

endpoints.name: tiktok.shopProducts
endpoints.description: Products listed by a TikTok Shop seller. Pass the seller's handle or a shop URL. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: url
params.description: Seller handle (@shopname) or a TikTok shop URL

params.name: region
params.description: Two-letter market code (US, GB, ID…). TikTok feeds and catalogues are per-market.

endpoints.name: tiktok.shopSearch
endpoints.description: Product search across TikTok Shop. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: region
params.description: Two-letter market code (US, GB, ID…). TikTok feeds and catalogues are per-market.

endpoints.name: tiktok.song
endpoints.description: Details for a TikTok sound: title, artist, album, cover, clip length, and how many videos use it. Read from the music page, so it needs no signer.

params.name: song
params.description: Music id, or a full tiktok.com/music/… URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.songVideos
endpoints.description: TikToks built on a given sound — the endpoint behind "who is using my track". Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: song
params.description: Music id, or a full tiktok.com/music/… URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.popularSongs
endpoints.description: Sounds trending in a market — the endpoint behind music A&R and sync-licensing research. From TikTok's Creative Center.

params.name: region
params.description: Two-letter market code (US, GB, ID…). TikTok feeds and catalogues are per-market.

endpoints.name: tiktok.transcript
endpoints.description: The spoken transcript of a TikTok, as one text block plus timed cues. Returns the ORIGINAL spoken-language track by default rather than whichever track TikTok lists first, so the text reflects what was actually said. Pass `language` for a specific track — a miss is an error listing what is available, never a silent substitution into another language.

params.name: url
params.description: Video URL (preferred), share link, or numeric video id

params.name: language
params.description: BCP-47 or ISO-639 code, e.g. "en", "es", "pt-BR". Omit for the original spoken track.

endpoints.name: tiktok.trending
endpoints.description: TikTok's logged-out For You feed for a region — what the platform is pushing to a brand-new visitor right now. Not a ranking anyone can reproduce: TikTok personalises even the anonymous feed, so two calls a second apart return different videos. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: region
params.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, GB, DE

endpoints.name: tiktok.userShowcase
endpoints.description: Products a creator has pinned to their profile showcase — what they are actually promoting, as opposed to what they sell. Requires a configured TikTok signer.

params.name: region
params.description: Two-letter market code (US, GB, ID…). TikTok feeds and catalogues are per-market.

endpoints.name: tiktok.userVideos
endpoints.description: A creator's public posts, newest first, with view/like/comment/share counts. Photo posts are included and typed as `image` or `carousel`. Paging past the first response requires a configured TikTok signer; without one the first page still returns from the profile page itself, and `raw.via` says which path answered.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@nike), or a full tiktok.com profile URL

endpoints.name: tiktok.video
endpoints.description: Full public metadata for one TikTok: caption, hashtags, mentions, author, sound, duration, and view/like/comment/share counts. Photo posts return every image in `mediaUrls`. Accepts a full URL, a share link (vm.tiktok.com), or a numeric video id.

params.name: url
params.description: Video URL (preferred), share link, or numeric video id

endpoints.name: tiktok.popularVideos
endpoints.description: Videos trending in a market over a trailing window, from TikTok's Creative Center. Distinct from `/v1/tiktok/trending`, which is the personalised For You feed.

params.name: region
params.description: Two-letter market code (US, GB, ID…). TikTok feeds and catalogues are per-market.

params.name: handle

endpoints.name: twitch.userVideos

params.name: handle
params.description: Channel login (shroud), or a twitch.tv URL

params.name: filter_by

endpoints.name: twitter.community
endpoints.description: Public details for an X Community: name, description, member count, topic, join policy, banner and the creator's handle. Read from the server-rendered community page, which X still serves to logged-out callers.

params.name: url
params.description: Community URL (x.com/i/communities/...) or the numeric id

endpoints.name: twitter.communityTweets
endpoints.description: Recent posts in an X Community, with likes, retweets, replies and **view counts** — the community page publishes metrics X's embed CDN does not. One page only: X serves logged-out callers a single rendered batch and no continuation token, so `hasMore` is always false.

params.name: url
params.description: Community URL (x.com/i/communities/...) or the numeric id

endpoints.name: twitter.profile
endpoints.description: Public profile for an X account. With server-side credentials set this is the full profile — bio, location, follower/following/post counts, join date. Without one, X exposes only handle, id, display name, avatar and verified status to logged-out callers, and the call is refunded to 0 credits because that is not worth charging for.

params.name: handle

params.name: url

endpoints.name: twitter.tweetTranscript

Sourced from the caption track in the video's HLS playlist, which is the only transcript X exposes to logged-out callers — posts whose author never attached captions return an empty result and are not charged.

params.name: url
params.description: Post URL (x.com/user/status/123...) or a bare post id

params.name: language
params.description: BCP-47 code, e.g. "en". Defaults to the first track.

endpoints.name: twitter.userTweets
endpoints.description: An account's recent public posts. With server-side credentials this pages through the timeline with real engagement metrics; without one it returns the single page X's embedded timeline exposes (roughly 20 posts, likes and replies only).

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@jack), or a full x.com profile URL

params.name: count
params.description: Posts per page, 5-100. Default 20. Official API only.

params.name: cursor
params.description: `pagination.cursor` from a previous response. Official API only.

endpoints.name: youtube.channel
endpoints.description: Public details for a YouTube channel: subscribers, video count, description, links.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@mrbeast), channel id (UC...), or full URL

endpoints.name: youtube.channelCommunityPosts
endpoints.description: A channel's Posts tab (what YouTube used to call Community). Images, multi-image carousels, shared videos and polls all come back as posts; poll options are under `raw`.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@mrbeast), channel id (UC…), or full URL

endpoints.name: youtube.channelLives

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@mrbeast), channel id (UC…), or full URL

endpoints.name: youtube.channelPlaylists
endpoints.description: Playlists a channel has made public. Pass an `id` from here to /v1/youtube/playlist for the videos in it.

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@mrbeast), channel id (UC…), or full URL

endpoints.name: youtube.channelShorts
endpoints.description: A channel's Shorts grid, newest first, about 48 per page. Shorts carry no duration or publish date on this surface — YouTube does not render either — so both are null rather than guessed.

params.name: handle

endpoints.name: youtube.channelVideos

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle (@mrbeast), channel id, or full URL

params.description: Post URL (youtube.com/post/Ugk…) or bare post id

params.name: playlist_id
params.description: Playlist id (PL…), or any URL containing `list=`

endpoints.name: youtube.search
endpoints.description: Public YouTube search results for a query.

endpoints.name: youtube.searchHashtag

params.name: hashtag
params.description: Hashtag, with or without the leading #

endpoints.name: youtube.searchTypeahead
endpoints.description: YouTube's own search suggestions for a partial query — the autocomplete list the search box shows. Useful as a keyword-research signal: these are ranked by what people actually search for.

endpoints.name: youtube.trendingShorts
endpoints.description: Shorts YouTube is currently surfacing, by region. Note that YouTube retired the global Trending feed — /feed/trending now serves the ordinary home feed — so this reads the ranked Shorts surface instead, which is what still exists. Results differ per request; it is deliberately not subscribable.

endpoints.name: youtube.transcript
endpoints.description: Full transcript for a YouTube video, as one text block plus timed cues. Returns the requested language when available, otherwise the default track.

endpoints.name: youtube.video
endpoints.description: Public metadata for a YouTube video or Short, including view/like counts.

endpoints.name: youtube.commentReplies
endpoints.description: Replies to one comment thread. Takes a `cursor` from the `replyCursors` list on `/v1/youtube/video/comments`, or — as a convenience — a video `url` plus `comment_id`, in which case we locate the thread on the first comment page for you.
constraints: Pass either `cursor` (from `replyCursors` on /v1/youtube/video/comments), or both `url` and `comment_id`.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Reply cursor from `/v1/youtube/video/comments`, or `pagination.cursor` to page deeper

params.name: url
params.description: Video URL or id — required only when using `comment_id`

params.name: comment_id
params.description: Top-level comment id (Ugx…) to fetch replies for

endpoints.name: youtube.videoComments
endpoints.description: Top-level comments on a video, about 20 per page. Pass `pagination.cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page. Each item that has replies also appears in `replyCursors`; feed that cursor to `/v1/youtube/video/comment-replies`. Use `order=newest` when polling for new comments — `top` is re-ranked by YouTube and will churn.

endpoints.name: youtube.videoSponsors
endpoints.description: Brands, promo codes and affiliate links inferred from a video's description, plus YouTube's own paid-promotion disclosure. Every signal carries the description line it was read from and a confidence, because this is inference over prose — YouTube publishes no structured sponsor data. Experimental: expect to check `evidence` before acting on `low` confidence.
